summary.result: Using optimum design method, cantilever retaining wall will be designed more economi- cally and reasonably than using traditional design method.
summary.background: In this study, the algorithm for the optimum design of cantilever retaining wall was de veloped and solved using Modified Method of Feasible Directions(MMFD), Sequential Linear Programming(SLP) and Sequential Quadratic Programming(SQP).
summary.method: It is expected that the optimum design algorithm developed in this study can be utilized efficiently for the optimum design of any scale cantilever retaining wall.
